speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Hi Karolina, thanks for making time. This is the 30-minute screening for the Senior Rust Engineer role at a seed-stage Solana DeFi startup in Warsaw.

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Hi Ola, nice to meet.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Let's start with Rust. How long have you been writing Rust in production, and where?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Six years of production Rust. Three years on a payments backend with tokio and actix, then three years of on-chain Rust at Kelp Labs.

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: I own code reviews for the program repo and I set up our clippy and deny rules.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Which Solana programs have you shipped to mainnet?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: The lending pool and the liquidation programs, both on mainnet since 2024. We started on Anchor 0.29 and I migrated us to 0.31. I also maintain the swap program.

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Last spring I moved the pool vaults to Token-2022, with a feature-flagged migration over two weeks.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Tell me about the DeFi side. What did you design yourself?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Kelp is a DEX plus a lending protocol, about forty million dollars TVL at peak. I designed the liquidation thresholds with our risk lead and wrote the interest-rate model in fixed-point math.

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: In March I handled the oracle staleness incident and added a max-age check on Pyth prices.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: How do you approach program security? Fuzzing, tests, audits?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: I wrote the Trident fuzz suite for the lending program. It found two real bugs, a rounding issue in share minting and a missing signer check. We went through audits with OtterSec and Neodyme, and I fixed all the findings and wrote the response doc.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: The team works in English. How comfortable are you with that?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Very comfortable. I write Kelp's audit responses in English and I present at our community calls.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: The role is two days a week in the Warsaw office. Are you only looking for fully remote work?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: No, I prefer hybrid. I live in Mokotów and I already go to the Kelp office twice a week.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Why are you looking to move now?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Kelp is pivoting to perps and I want to stay in lending. A credit marketplace is exactly that, and I like working in a small team directly with the founder.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Last one: notice period, compensation, and are you in other processes?

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: One month notice on B2B. I'm expecting thirty-two to thirty-six thousand PLN a month plus tokens. I'm in one other process, early stage.

speaker: Ola Wiśniewska
text: Great, Karolina, that's everything from me. I'll pass this to the team and you'll hear back within a few days.

speaker: Karolina Mazurek
text: Thanks, talk soon.
